item.text: I’ll fix the snapshot assertion to separate committed state from fresh server time, then correct the mobile layout and preserve smoke-test screenshots on failure. Deployment remains blocked pending the parent’s host rerun.

The mobile grid’s text column used its heading’s minimum width, which could force the layout wider than 375px. I’ve made the tracks shrinkable and added wrapping for long content, without clipping or hiding it. The smoke check will cover the Atlas and stop page at 375px, plus the overlay at 160px, and save captures even if a later assertion fails.
